remarks: Asking for best offers by Tuesday 7/21 at 9am. Welcome to 17 Rex Street, where charm & comfort come together in one of Greenwich's most convenient neighborhoods. Set within the Glenville School District, the home enjoys excellent proximity to parks, schools, shopping, dining, highways, & public transportation. Just minutes from the heart of Glenville, you'll enjoy quick access to some of Greenwich's newest restaurants, shops, & neighborhood conveniences. A welcoming front porch invites you into bright living spaces designed for easy living. The first-floor features multiple gathering spaces, a dining room, & kitchen, while the second-floor offers 3 bedrooms & 1 full bath. A flat, private backyard provides a setting for outdoor dining, play, or gardening. An unfinished LL offers addtl space. 17 Rex is a wonderful place to call home.
